settings.description: Encoded process transport ceiling in bytes; independent of typed JSON admission.

settings.binding: Native Get<FoundationTransportOptions> binds Foundation:Transport at process startup; Apply validates and sets native Kestrel limits.
settings.description: Encoded process transport ceiling in bytes; independent of typed JSON admission.

semanticConstraints: Host binds Foundation:Transport once before Kestrel startup and applies limits before accepting requests.
Transport limits are process-wide and independent of decoded JSON/shell response budgets and reverse-proxy settings.
Configuration precedence: native WebApplication defaults, optional hostsettings.json, optional web-profile.shells.json, required shells.json, environment variables, command-line arguments.
All three explicitly added JSON files use reloadOnChange:false; changing transport settings requires process restart.

settings.binding: Native Get<FoundationBootOptions> binds Foundation:Boot when the startup hosted service begins.
settings.description: Startup shell activation policy; does not register or select application features.

settings.binding: Native Get<FoundationBootOptions> binds Foundation:Boot when the startup hosted service begins.
settings.description: Startup shell activation policy; does not register or select application features.

semanticConstraints: Host binds Foundation:Boot once during its hosted startup service, before listening.
EagerShellActivation=false skips eager checks/activation; later native lazy shell activation remains available.
FailOnShellActivationError=false catches ordinary activation errors, logs them and permits later lazy activation; caller cancellation is never swallowed.
Required feature identity/catalog and absent-shell errors still fail eager startup before activation; the flag does not suppress those configuration errors.
Changing this startup-only policy requires restarting the Host.
